author: reek
body: A bare [Gpu] row is a FAMILY grant and must reach the runtime.

author: reek
body: `Gpu` covers Gpu.Memory by the dotted sub-effect lattice, so this opening type-checks and gpu-mem-write is legal in its body. The question this test asks is whether the CAPABILITY survives the manifest: `manifest-cap-id` must know the name "Gpu", or the effect is silently dropped from the binary's capability section, the process never earns bit 18, and emit-gpu-mem-guard refuses the write.
